Hi Maya — great to hear and glad the demo was useful. Summary / quick answers below and next steps attached.

Summary answers:
- Vendor packet: attached (redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf). It includes legal name, EIN, remit contact, a sample commercial SOW, and our standard onboarding checklist.
- PO lead time: for Hosted API we can generally onboard within 3–5 business days after PO and W-9 are received. For Dedicated deployments (reserved capacity) expect 3–4 weeks for provisioning and network setup plus paperwork.
- Marketplace: we support listing on AWS Marketplace in select engagements; for this account we can evaluate marketplace billing but it usually requires 60–90 day procurement lead time and additional marketplace terms.

What I need from you to pick the path:
1) Preferred billing route: PO | card | marketplace (please confirm)
2) If PO: send W-9 (or W-8 for non-US), remit bank details or their portal URL, and preferred PO template (we can return a commercial SOW and quote).
3) If marketplace: confirm marketplace of choice and whether your procurement requires marketplace-specific contract language.

Next steps I propose:
- I will attach our vendor packet now.
- If Tom and procurement confirm PO, they can send the W-9 and banking PDF to finance@redwood.com and cc me; I'll loop in our billing ops to get a purchase order number and expedite provisioning.

I attached: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf (vendor packet, W-9 request language, standard remit). Also linking our onboarding checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-onboarding.

If easier, happy to hop on a 15-min call with Tom this week to walk through what the PO needs to include.

Best,
